{{Infobox auto|Curry Stock}}

A '''stock''' is an uncooked soup base that is cooked into one of the five oven meals. There are five: '''curry stock''', '''green curry stock''', '''paneer curry stock''', '''pumpkin curry stock''' and '''ramen stock'''. Each is crafted in a [[bowl]] and then cooked for 15 seconds in an [[oven]]; all but pumpkin curry stock can also be cooked on [[kindling]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/green_curry.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
Picking up a bowl unlocks all five stock recipes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/bowl.json}}</ref> Crafting green curry, paneer curry or pumpkin curry stock returns the glass bottles of its [[oil]] and [[Milk Bottle|milk bottle]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/two_glass_bottles_from_crafting.json}}</ref> Curry and ramen stock are meant to return the oil's bottle, but in 1.12.2-beta the advancement that does this still names their recipes by old IDs, so it is used up.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==

Obtaining a stock unlocks its oven meal. Stocks can't be eaten.

== Trivia ==
* Stocks are renamed spawn eggs (strider, zombified piglin, zoglin, ghast and wither skeleton).
